snippet.title: Tempest Tower - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Tempest Tower today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123800/Tempest_Tower/

Tempest Tower redefines Tower Defense with a dynamic blend of classic base-building and electrifying player-driven combat. Explore, plan, and meticulously construct your base during the Build Phase. Execute, adapt, and ruthlessly brawl with hordes of Creepers during the Action Phase. Every level is a thrilling test of strategy and skill.

Find out a little more about the process we went through to make the Announcement Trailer by checking out our blog: https://halfpastyellow.com/blog/2025/01/11/Tempest-Tower-First-Look.html

Tempest Tower is being developed by award winning studio, Half Past Yellow. It will be their first self-published title.
